name: Customer Relationship Management
description: System of record for customer identity, account structure, service cases, and activity history; the context provider that makes every other system personal and consistent.
roleInCenter: Single source of truth for who the customer is, what they own, and what happened before this contact.

glossary.definition: Top-level business entity owning products, billing, and entitlements
Person associated with one or more accounts, with phone/email identities
Unit of work tracking a customer issue from open to resolved disposition
Parent-child relationships for households or organizations with sub-accounts
Routing-triggered automatic display of customer context at the moment an agent answers
Chronological record of interactions and touches attached to account or case
Record of what contact and recording uses the customer has agreed to, per jurisdiction
Golden record after matching/merge across duplicates and channels
Coded contact outcome written back at wrap-up; feeds reporting and QA disposition accuracy
Headline customer state (tenure, open cases, last contact, risk flags) shown to agents in one glance

metrics.name: Screen Pop Adoption
metrics.definition: Share of answered contacts where context displayed automatically before first response

metrics.name: Context Carry-Over Rate
metrics.definition: Share of repeat contacts where history was readable without customer re-explaining

metrics.name: Average Wrap-Up Time
metrics.definition: Mean after-contact work completing CRM logging and case updates

metrics.name: Duplicate Contact Record Rate
metrics.definition: Share of records flagged as duplicate or merge candidates

failureModes.name: Context Blindness
failureModes.signal: Customers re-explain; VOC repeat-contact drivers dominated by history gap
failureModes.mitigation: Screen pop plus context banner scan mandatory in QA rubric

failureModes.name: Swivel-Chair Logging
failureModes.signal: Wrap codes inconsistent; ACW ballooning in CRM tools with poor UX
failureModes.mitigation: Streamlined wrap flow, disposition presets from case type

failureModes.name: Identity Fragmentation
failureModes.signal: Duplicate accounts proliferating; fragmented history on new channels
failureModes.mitigation: Background matching job; channel keys normalized to master identity

failureModes.name: Consent Zoning Error
failureModes.signal: QA auto-fails around recording or outreach despite recorded consent elsewhere
failureModes.mitigation: Consent state must be surfaced in context banner with jurisdiction rules

scoringModel.name: CRM Identity & Golden Record Integrity Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution, Golden Record conflict entropy, sub-second screen-pop hydration, and jurisdiction-aware consent fidelity.

dimensions.name: Identity Resolution & Golden Record Precision
dimensions.description: Accuracy of cross-channel entity matching, deduplication, and master contact identity linking prior to agent connection
sampleCriteria: Inbound ANI, email, or session token resolves to unique Golden Record with >0.95 posterior probability
Duplicate contact record rate stays below 1.5 percent across active accounts
Account hierarchy and entitlement tiers hydrate accurately without manual lookup

dimensions.name: Screen-Pop Hydration & Context Carry-Over
dimensions.description: Sub-second delivery of unified context banner, open cases, and prior interaction history at the moment of ACD answer
sampleCriteria: Screen pop renders complete context banner within 400 milliseconds of call answer
Prior 90-day omnichannel interaction timeline visible in single pane without swivel-chair lookup
Customer is never asked to repeat case number or verified identity attributes

dimensions.name: Entity Attribute Freshness & Conflict Suppression
dimensions.description: Low conflict entropy across multi-source profile attributes and timely decay refresh for contact methods and entitlements
sampleCriteria: Golden Record conflict entropy across billing, phone, and address fields equals zero after MDM survivorship rules
Stale attributes older than freshness half-life trigger proactive verification prompts
Mid-call profile updates propagate synchronously across linked sub-accounts

dimensions.name: Consent State & Jurisdiction Governance
dimensions.description: Real-time enforcement of recording, service contact, and marketing opt-in consent flags matched to customer jurisdiction
sampleCriteria: Jurisdiction-specific recording consent state is enforced before media forking begins
Do-not-contact and suppression flags synchronize to outbound engines within 60 seconds
Every consent mutation writes an immutable cryptographic audit log entry

dimensions.name: Post-Contact Wrap & Case Write-Back Integrity
dimensions.description: Structured disposition coding, automated interaction logging, and low-ACW case closure accuracy
sampleCriteria: Wrap code and case disposition match QA-verified resolution outcome
Automated summary and transcript link attach to case activity log before ACW close
Mean wrap-up duration stays below 30 seconds through preset case workflows

stateVariables.description: Continuous Bayesian posterior probability that an inbound session maps to canonical Golden Record entity m
Exponentially decaying reliability weight exp(-lambda_attr * Delta_t) of an entity attribute last verified Delta_t seconds ago
Shannon conflict entropy across competing source-system values for Golden Record attributes prior to survivorship reconciliation
Continuous hydration latency from ACD routing ring event to complete rendering of the CRM context banner

differentialEquations.name: Entity Attribute Freshness Exponential Decay
differentialEquations.formula: phi_attr(Delta_t) = exp(-lambda_attr cdot Delta_t), with dphi_attr(t) cdot dt^-1 = -lambda_attr cdot phi_attr(t) + (1 - phi_attr(t)) cdot delta(t - t_verify)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Attribute reliability decays continuously at rate lambda_attr over elapsed time Delta_t and resets to unity upon live verification at t_verify

differentialEquations.name: Continuous Fellegi-Sunter Identity Resolution Posterior Flow
differentialEquations.formula: d_logit_P_id(t) = sum_k phi_attr(Delta_t_k) cdot LLR_k(x_k(t)) dt - gamma_frag cdot H_mdm(t) dt
differentialEquations.interpretation: Log-odds of Golden Record identity accumulate freshness-weighted log-likelihood ratios LLR_k from observed keys x_k while MDM conflict entropy penalizes certainty

differentialEquations.name: Golden Record Conflict Entropy & Hydration Dynamics
differentialEquations.formula: dH_mdm(t) cdot dt^-1 = nu_ingest cdot I_divergent(t) - mu_sync cdot H_mdm(t), with L_pop(t) = L_base + alpha_ent cdot H_mdm(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Unsynchronized multi-channel writes inject conflict entropy at rate nu_ingest while MDM reconciliation decays it at rate mu_sync, directly bounding screen-pop latency L_pop

scaleInvariants: Commutative monoid merge invariance: CRDT and Fellegi-Sunter log-likelihood updates produce identical Golden Record states regardless of channel ingestion order
O(1) pre-contact hydration latency via blocking-key inverted indices and materialized context banners across 100M+ customer profiles
Dimensionless freshness scaling: normalizing elapsed time by attribute half-life lambda_attr^-1 collapses heterogeneous field decay curves onto exp(-tau)
